Werbung/Einladung 

Das Leben genießen – mitten auf der Donau!

Habt ihr Wien schon mal aus dieser Perspektive erlebt? Ich habe ein absolutes Highlight für euch entdeckt, das auf jede Wiener Bucketlist gehört: Das @_sauna_boat_wien_ 

Ihr mietet euch die stylische Panoramasauna inklusive eigenem Kapitän und schippert tiefenentspannt über das Wasser.

Mein Avaganza-Insider-Tipp: Hinter dem Boot steckt kein Geringerer als das geniale Team vom @taiga.spa! Bucht unbedingt die professionell geführten Taiga Spa-Rituale an Bord dazu. Die Kombination aus der Hitze des Holzofens, den traditionellen Zeremonien und dem Blick auf die Skyline lässt euch den Alltag komplett vergessen. Danach geht es zur perfekten Abkühlung direkt vom Deck hinein in die Donau – einfach magisch!

Das Angebot auf einen Blick:

*  Exklusive Cruise: Für private Gruppen (inkl. Panoramasauna, Kapitän, Holzofen & Open-Air-Terrasse). Kosten ab €450 für 3 Stunden
*  Taiga Spa an Bord: Ganzheitliche, traditionelle Wellness-Rituale mitten auf dem Wasser.
*  Inklusive: Frischer Tee, Wasser und kleine Snacks für die perfekte Me-Time.

📍 Startpunkt ist direkt bei der Marina Wien (Handelskai 343, 1020 Wien).

Alle Infos und Buchungsmöglichkeiten findet ihr auf der Homepage von Sauna Boat Wien.

Chocolate fondue on a floating igloo boat in London? 🍫⛵

We went aboard Skuna Boats’ Igloo Boat in Canary Wharf for a 30-minute guided trip around the Docklands, followed by an hour of fondue in the boat while it’s moored.

We chose chocolate fondue, which comes with fruit and sweet treats for dipping. You can choose cheese fondue instead, or upgrade to have both. The private igloos hold up to nine people, so it works for a date or a group outing.

Fancy another way to get on the water? Skuna also has hot tub boats, BBQ boats and floating saunas.

📍 Skuna Boats, West India Quay, Canary Wharf

biography:
Aqua Ignis (Bathhouse and Sauna)
More than a bathhouse, a whole bathing experience

latestPosts.caption:
Introducing The Bathhouse Summer Pass.

Our new 12-week weekday membership, designed to make bathing part of your weekly rhythm.

Visit the bathhouse up to 4 times per week, Tuesday–Friday, for 12 weeks! That’s up to 48 sessions throughout your pass.

$47/week when paid upfront
or
$57/week by weekly direct debit.

Available to purchase October–December 2026.

If you’ve been wanting to make the bathhouse part of your regular rhythm, this is for you.

Some gentle house keeping as we are a shared space, held with care.

Quiet where it’s needed. Connection where it feels natural. A rhythm we all move within together.
Before you arrive, during your soak, and as you leave. These small rituals shape the experience for everyone.

Thank you for moving gently here.

Sydney siders - your first blackheath bath, done properly.

Less than two from the city, and everything softens.

We are also across the road from Blackheath Station 🚉

Book your getaway.

Women, are you cold plunging with your body or against it?

Your hormones shift throughout the month, and so can your response to cold.

Some days, a plunge feels invigorating. Other days, warmth is what your body needs.

Cold exposure isn’t a competition. Listen to your body, not the protocol.

Save this guide for your next bath.

What could change in 12 weeks?

Long enough for something you occasionally make time for to become part of how you live.

This summer, make bathing your weekly rhythm. A morning sauna before the day begins. A mineral soak when your body needs to slow down. An hour or two that already has a place in your week.

The Bathhouse Summer Pass gives you access up to four times per week, Tuesday–Friday, for 12 weeks — up to 48 visits across the season.

$47/week when paid upfront, or $57/week by weekly direct debit.

Make this your change for summer.

Bushwalk → Bathhouse.

A Blue Mountains ritual we can get behind.

Pick a trail, spend a few hours amongst the gums, then make your way to Blackheath for warm mineral water, sauna, steam and tired-leg recovery.

The walk feels even better when you know this is waiting at the end.

Save for your next Blue Mountains weekend and book your bath for after the trail.

Unveiling a little something to take home from the bathhouse.

Our new Aqua Ignis tees, made ethically with our friends at @moonface.clothing 

Available now at the bathhouse.

For a few weeks each year, Blackheath turns pink.

Blossoms through town, blue skies, warmer days and the mountains in full spring mode.

Come up for the blooms and the bushwalks. Finish the day soaking with us.

📍Aqua Ignis, Blackheath 
(less than two hours from Sydney.)

Bushwalk → Bathhouse. Our favourite way to do the Blue Mountains.

Spend the morning on the trail, then follow your tired legs to Blackheath for 90 minutes of mineral bathing, sauna, steam and rest.

Fresh air first. Warm water after.

📍@aqua.ignis.blackheath

Save this one for your next weekend out of Sydney, and book your bath for after the walk.

First time at Aqua Ignis? We’ve thought of the little things.

Your bath includes a large towel and a small towel, with robes, slippers and additional towels available to hire for a little extra comfort between spaces.

And when it’s time to return to the world, you’ll find hairdryers downstairs so there’s no need to rush.

Add any extras when you book online, or simply ask us when you arrive.

- Aqua / Ignis

More recovery.
More ritual.
More reasons to slow down.

What is Aufguss? 
A sauna ritual rooted in Central European tradition where heat,scent, and movement are guided to deepen your experience.

While not originally Nordic, Aufguss has become a beloved part of modern sauna culture bringing a more immersive communal element to the ritual.

Experience it at Löyly during our Sweat Social Events on 4/3 and 5/15 and select Saturdays, included in a regular sauna visit. Come curious. Leave restored. 🤍
